work-productivity-nano-pdf-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release focused on supporting Nano Pdf-style workflow needs for agent users on Clawhub.
- Provides step-by-step plans, checklists, and templates to help with bug fixes, reliability, safety, and setup improvements.
- Designed for practical, local-hardware-friendly implementation (scripts, templates, small workflows).
- Triggers on requests involving work productivity, nano-pdf, pdf editing, or adjacent workflow automation needs.
- Includes built-in validation: each output addresses user requirements, is actionable, and highlights assumptions or next steps.
